definitions.explanation: A ticket that permits a passenger to ride on a train or other public transportation.

examples.japanese: {乗車券|じょうしゃけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}るには→乗る：00511_noru⟧{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{特急券|とっきゅうけん}→特急券：15799_tokkyuuken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: You need both a basic ticket and express ticket to ride the limited express.

examples.japanese: ⟦{券売機|けんばいき}→券売機：09553_kenbaiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a ticket at the ticket machine.

examples.english: If you have an IC card, you don't need to buy a ticket.

notes:
{乗車券|じょうしゃけん} is the basic fare ticket for riding trains and buses. Composed of ⟦{乗車|じょうしゃ}→乗車：06201_jousha⟧ (boarding) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket).

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
In Japan's train system, the {乗車券|じょうしゃけん} covers only the base fare. Riding limited express or reserved-seat trains requires additional tickets purchased separately.

TICKET TYPES:
- {乗車券|じょうしゃけん}: basic fare ticket
- ⟦{特急券|とっきゅうけん}→特急券：15799_tokkyuuken⟧: limited express surcharge ticket
- ⟦{指定席券|していせきけん}→指定席券：17902_shiteisekiken⟧: reserved seat ticket
- ⟦{回数券|かいすうけん}→回数券：08451_kaisuuken⟧: book of discount tickets
- ⟦{定期券|ていきけん}→定期券：01064_teikiken⟧: commuter pass

MODERN ALTERNATIVES:
IC cards (Suica, PASMO, ICOCA, etc.) have largely replaced paper {乗車券|じょうしゃけん} for everyday travel.

REGISTER:
{乗車券|じょうしゃけん} is the formal/official term. In casual speech, ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧ (ticket) or ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧ are more common.
